query:
-- MANUSCRIPTS (AX2)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS perfumum_manuscripts (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  manuscript_id VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  title VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,
  language VARCHAR(100),
  date_range VARCHAR(50),
  repository VARCHAR(255),
  region VARCHAR(100),
  license ENUM('CC-BY', 'CC-BY-SA', 'CC0', 'All-rights-reserved', 'Unknown') DEFAULT 'Unknown',
  scan_url VARCHAR(500),
  ocr_status ENUM('queued', 'in_progress', 'completed', 'failed', 'manual') DEFAULT 'queued',
  tags JSON,
  notes TEXT,
  axis_id VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'AX2_ETHNOBOTANY_COMP',
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  INDEX pm_region_idx (region)
);

-- TEXT FRAGMENTS (AX2)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS text_fragments (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  fragment_id VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  manuscript_id VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
  language VARCHAR(100),
  original_text TEXT,
  translation_fr TEXT,
  translation_en TEXT,
  entities JSON,
  evidence_level ENUM('confirmed', 'probable', 'hypothetical') DEFAULT 'hypothetical',
  notes TEXT,
  axis_id VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'AX2_ETHNOBOTANY_COMP',
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  INDEX tf_manuscript_idx (manuscript_id)
);

-- TRADE ROUTES (AX2)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS trade_routes (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  route_id VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  time_start INT,
  time_end INT,
  nodes JSON,
  materials JSON,
  notes TEXT,
  sources JSON,
  axis_id VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'AX2_ETHNOBOTANY_COMP',
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
